name: Manhunt
summary: In Elwynn Forest, Marshal Dughan sends you to find the Collector, a Defias bagman. He works from the overrun Brackwell Pumpkin Patch and sends stolen gold from the forest's mines to the Brotherhood.

sections.title: Justice in the Pumpkin Patch
sections.body: Marshal Dughan sends you to Brackwell Pumpkin Patch after Elwynn's gnolls are found carrying a schedule for gold pickups. Defias bandits and gnolls have taken over the once quiet homestead. The Collector hides among its overgrown vines, skimming ore from the kingdom's mines and arranging shipments for the growing rebellion.

sections.title: An Artisan's Seal
sections.body: After you slay the Collector, you recover his ring and deliver it to Marshal Dughan. The marshal is bewildered: its band bears the mark of Stormwind's old Stonemasons Guild, not a common criminal crest. The ring suggests the highwaymen choking Elwynn Forest are more than opportunists. Some were craftsmen who turned bitter and became outlaws after Stormwind was rebuilt.

faq.q: Where can I find the Collector?
faq.answer: The Collector hides at Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in southeastern Elwynn Forest, just east of the Maclure Vineyards and north of the river boundary.

faq.q: Why is the Collector stealing gold from Elwynn's mines?
faq.answer: The Collector gathers smuggled ore and extortion payments from the kobold-infested Fargodeep and Jasperlode mines to fund the Defias Brotherhood's covert operations across the kingdom.

faq.q: What is the significance of the Collector's ring?
faq.answer: The ring is a membership ring of the old Stonemasons Guild, whose craftsmen rebuilt Stormwind City after the First War. Marshal Dughan cannot explain why a lowly thief working with the Defias carries an artisan guild ring, and hopes the question will one day be answered.

faq.q: Does Marshal Dughan figure out who is behind the Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Not immediately. Marshal Dughan recognizes the artisan insignia on the ring, but cannot explain why a common thief carries an artisan guild signet. The wider conspiracy remains an open question in Goldshire.

faq.q: Who sends you on this manhunt?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan, the garrison commander at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, offers you this work after you recover the Defias pickup schedule.

faq.q: What happened to the Brackwell family?
faq.answer: The Brackwell Pumpkin Patch lies in ruin, abandoned by its owners and occupied by Defias rogues, bandits, and encroaching Riverpaw gnolls that prowl the southeastern woodlands.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can see how the Collector's covert work reflects the growing network of highwaymen and cutpurses taking root throughout Elwynn Forest.
As an Alliance member, you help protect Stormwind's local resources. Stopping the Collector cuts off an illicit flow of kingdom gold meant to fund rebellion near the capital.
As a human, you may feel the weight of recovering the Stonemason's ring. It recalls the bitter labor disputes that divided the kingdom after Stormwind was rebuilt.
